objective: Operationalize the P18 24x7 Demo learning contract with a persistent worker, scheduled reference runtime, durable checkpoint/resume, retries, telemetry, alerts and bounded soak validation.
scope: Add a generic Continuous Demo Learning runtime that repeatedly drives LearningLoopCoordinator
Persist stage evidence and LoopCheckpoint state atomically to JSON and resume after process restart
Add stage-executor, market-watermark, system-state, clock, sleeper, telemetry and alert interfaces
Retry failed stages with bounded backoff and enter SAFE_HOLD after the configured failure threshold
Build non-synthetic reference stage evidence from public-market data plus same-run canonical P18 lineage evidence
Add a CLI worker for one or more complete Demo-only cycles
Add an hourly scheduled GitHub Actions reference runtime for the public repository
Add bounded multi-cycle soak and restart/resume tests
Reconcile P18 closure/current-state/task documentation and issue #383
out_of_scope: Long-term production infrastructure outside the free scheduled reference runtime
dependencies: Public repository standard GitHub Actions availability
tests: Checkpoint persists after each stage and a new runtime instance resumes correctly
Stage skipping remains impossible through LearningLoopCoordinator
Repeated stage failures enter SAFE_HOLD and emit alert evidence
Bounded soak completes at least 20 cycles without checkpoint corruption or authority escalation
Reference stage bundle is derived from public market and canonical lineage evidence, not placeholder hashes
Scheduled workflow is security-pinned and requires no secrets
security_tests: Scheduled workflow contents permission is read-only
rollback: Disable/remove the scheduled reference runtime and revert FIN-P18-WI-001-R01 runtime files; retain the validated P18 operating contract and P19 remains unstarted.
definition_of_done: Runtime worker drives all nine ordered stages
Durable checkpoint/resume and retry/alert controls pass
Non-synthetic reference stage bundle is used
